title: Upcoming bus
description: A normalized upcoming-bus record returned by backend/transit.py. Route identifiers are strings to preserve leading zeros and nonnumeric route names.

route.description: The route label shown to the rider (for example, GTFS route_short_name), not a GTFS route_id.

stop.description: The name of the stop for this arrival.

arrives_in_min.description: Minutes until arrival; zero means arriving now.
